title: FileContext
description: An m:n join between a File and a context it appears in (a chat message, a task, a post): `fileRef` and `contextRef` are w3ds envelope URIs. Exists because the same File can be referenced by many contexts and a context can carry many files, while neither side should embed the other. Written by the platform that placed the file into the context; public ACL so any platform can answer 'where has this file been used'.
